_about: The first minute against the first rival (scripts/lessons.gd): each step is shown once with a held wind-up and a cue read before the blow; one retry; then he fights for real. read_frames: the cue is up this long before he strikes. hold: extra wind-up frames at the coil (a slower, readable blow). open_frames: how long he stands open after the right answer. max_frames: the lessons end by this round frame whatever happened. rivals.<key>: the same steps for a later rival's first round (rung 1-2, never a champion); the Duelist teaches his tap, blocking his first blade and his thrust (round 11), the Dancer her spin heavy and her first cut (round 12); damage_k: the share of damage he takes while they run, so a newcomer's punishes do not KO him before he has taught them.
done: That is all he knows. Now he fights for real.

steps.cue: He raises the mace: HOLD SPACE (or L) to block it.
steps.next_cue: Blocked! He bounced off your guard: hit him NOW (LMB / J).

steps.cue: Watch for the glint on his mace, then TAP SPACE as it lands: PARRY.
steps.next_cue: PARRY! He is thrown open: a HEAVY (RMB / K) cannot miss.

steps.cue: He hides behind his shield. E: your shoulder breaks a guard.

duelist.done: His tap, his first blade, his thrust. Now he fights for real.

steps.cue: He TAPS HIS BLADE before every string: strike him WHILE he taps (LMB / J).
steps.next_cue: COUNTER! A hit in his tap is a counter-hit: that is your way in.

steps.cue: His blade is out FIRST: do not swing into it. HOLD SPACE to block his light.
steps.next_cue: Blocked! Now strike in the GAP after his swing (LMB / J).

steps.cue: He draws back for a THRUST: TAP SPACE as it lands to PARRY.
steps.next_cue: PARRIED! A LIGHT (LMB / J) is guaranteed now.

dancer.done: Her spin, her flurry. Now she dances for real.

steps.cue: She coils for a SPIN: HOLD SPACE to block it.
steps.next_cue: Blocked! Any HEAVY staggers her: RMB / K now.

steps.cue: Her blades are FAST: do not swing into them. HOLD SPACE to block her first cut.
steps.next_cue: Blocked! Strike in the GAP before her next cut (LMB / J).
